needs.what: Textures the game fills in place from the CPU and publishes with a pool flush are not uploaded: some textures may be missing or stale.
Textures the game rewrites in memory without telling NVN are not uploaded again (needs write tracking of guest pages).

nxnative gives this game a 4.75 GB heap region (nxweb: 1.50 GB) and a 16.00 GB alias region (nxweb: 1.87 GB); a game that sizes its heap from the memory pool it is told about will ask for more than a 4 GB WebAssembly memory can map (the pool nxweb reports would have to be smaller; not tried).
